Export .env file contents as JSON

Usage:
  ycy export env [dir] [flags]

Flags:
  -e, --env string   Environment name, skip interactive selection (e.g. local, prod)
  -h, --help         help for env
      --merge        Merge .env with the selected environment file
  -o, --out string   Write output to file instead of stdout

Global Flags:
      --log-format string   Diagnostic format: text or json
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
      --quiet               Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose             Enable debug diagnostics
